actor_loss.formula: -lambda * mean_i[Q1(s_i, pi(s_i)) - k * W(s_i, pi(s_i))] + (1 + nu) * mean_ij (pi(s_i)_j - a_ij)^2
actor_loss.frozen: W's own parameters (frozen critic, random network, simulator, constants) get no gradient: only the actor's parameters are differentiated, so W acts on the actor only through the command pi(s)
actor_loss.lam: lambda = alpha / stopgrad(mean_i |Q1(s_i, pi(s_i))|), computed on Q1 alone (W never enters it)
actor_loss.w0: with k W = 0 and nu = 0 the loss is learners.actor_step's unweighted expression term for term ((q - 0).mean(), and the cloning term times 1.0)

arms.how: trained by the gate's own unchanged code path (learners.ActorOnly.run, unweighted, the three critics of check 2 side by side) and checked against check 2's saved 'gapped' actor by parameter hash; the locked 'none' actor is check 2's saved actor
arms.name: none

arms.how: the new program with kW = 0, nu = 0; must match 'none' within 1e-5 on every parameter
arms.name: w0_check
perfect_band
arms.role: main oracle: the band a perfect BCA would have

arms.W: [e(s, a) - e(s, a_i)]_+, e(s, a) = Q1(s, a) - Q^c_250(s, a), Q^c_250 the stall-aware controller's value by a differentiable 250-step rollout through dynamics_jax (float32 in the program); e(s_i, a_i) at the recorded command precomputed once with the same function
arms.name: long_run_harm
arms.role: check 3's exact harm read as a value; reported

arms.name: even_pull
arms.role: gating control: check 3's caution at matched strength

arms.W: random network of the scale network's shape (Dense 64 - ReLU - Dense 64 - ReLU - Dense 1, softplus + 0.01; flax default initialisation; inputs obs / 1.001 and the command), frozen
arms.name: random_1
arms.role: gating control: same kind of penalty, random placement

arms.name: underrating_half

arms.name: state_shuffled_band
arms.role: does state placement add anything? reported

checks.a: the no-caution arm through the gate's unchanged code reproduces check 2's saved gapped-critic actor by parameter hash (every seed; stop on failure)
checks.b: the new program with W = 0 matches that actor within 1e-5 on every parameter (every seed; stop on failure)
checks.c: seed 0: the oracle at the gapped critic's actor's past-80% commands at training states has mean close to -0.73 and median size elsewhere close to 0.107 (readout_seed0.json, 3,000-row sample, Q1 form: -0.7298, 0.1066; reproduced on the same rows within 0.01 with the readout's Q1 form, the plan's min_h form reported beside it); |float32 in-program - float64| <= 1e-3 at every training row; its gradient along thruster-1 throttle finite on both sides of the 80% knee
checks.d: a 400-step run of every arm kind gives finite losses; timing per 1,000 steps per kind

deviations: Precision of the in-program simulator step: the plan asks for float64. A float64 step inside the float32 training program needs the program traced under jax enable_x64, which changes the gate's float32 actor arithmetic (measured before any room-test training, on random networks and random data: the gate's own actor-only program traced under enable_x64 differs by 1 ulp after one update). The step therefore runs in float32 with the same dynamics_jax function, as the gate's own check-3 oracle did (learners.LearnSettings.oracle_x64 = False). Its inputs are exact in float32; check (c) bounds the difference from the float64 step at every training row (tolerance 1e-3 value units; stop if exceeded).

Long-run harm arm: the 250-step differentiable rollout is used as written; no fitted-surface fallback. Pre-spec timing on seed 0 (pre_spec_timing below; random start actor, results discarded): 58 s per 1,000 steps against 3 s for a plain arm, about 19 minutes for its 20,000 steps, which keeps one seed near 1.3-1.5 process-hours, inside the plan's 1.5. (Unrolling the rollout's scan was slower.) e uses Q1 as the plan says; both e terms use the same float32 250-step function.

No-stall world: check 2's no-stall critics are stall-aware-controller critics (the gate trained no rising-thrust critic in that world), so the critic's own one-step error uses the stall-aware controller. That version is the no-stall perfect band; the plan's literal 'rising-thrust controller' version is run beside it and reported.

Ladders for push less and the random surfaces are not given in the plan: they are slope-normalised knobs 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10 (see slope_normalisation). All ladders get the declared blind extension rule.
Replication: 'the host's own actor' is taken as its target copy (the one its critic's Bellman target read).
The no-caution actor that is locked and scored is check 2's saved actor; check (a) shows the gate's code reproduces it bit for bit on every seed.

Room mark wording made exact: 'beats each gating control by at least 20 points' is the pooled mean of the paired strong-current difference; 'positive in at least 4 of 5 seeds' is applied to each such difference.
evaluation: acceptance._evaluate (learners.evaluate_actor): exact 100-step returns on the full 1,000-start banks of all four situations (recorded, strong current, big waves, big kicks), points against the gate's anchors (0 = recording controller, 100 = stall-aware controller), the same actor capped at 80%, the share of steps past 80%; plus, reported, the share past 80% per thruster from one more exact rollout per situation. Scored actors: none (check 2's saved actor), the cloned actor, every fixed arm except w0_check, and the matched arm of every gating control
label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 room test of the lower-edge channel (plan sections 4.0, 4.1, 7), computed outside the gate on saved gate artifacts; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA code was run (stand-ins and oracles only)
lock: after every arm is trained and matched, lock.json (+ .sha256) is written with every actor's parameter SHA-256 (learners.tree_sha256), the SHA-256 of actors.msgpack, the strengths, matches, coefficients, checks (a) and (b), spec.json's SHA-256 and the code's SHA-256. No return, points or score of any trained arm is computed before it exists; the evaluation phase verifies it first

marks.futility: seeds 0 and 1 run first; if the perfect band beats the matched even pull by less than 5 points in strong current on both seeds, stop and go to plan section 4.5 (seeds 2-4 are not run)
marks.keeps_improvement: recorded conditions: perfect band >= no caution - 2 and >= cloned actor + 25 (pooled means); big waves and big kicks: perfect band >= no caution - 3 (pooled means)
marks.pooled: means over seeds 0-4; every mark needs every seed (a missing or failed seed fails the mark)
marks.prediction_not_a_mark: perfect band 60-100 points in strong current (cap-at-80% ceiling 101.8, full-log actor 84.6); matched controls within -5 to +10 of no caution
marks.recovery: in strong current the perfect band is at least 49.5 points above no caution (pooled mean of the paired difference; half of check 2's 98.9-point harm)
marks.room: in strong current the perfect band beats each gating control (even_pull, push_less, random_1, random_2, each at its matched strength) by at least 20 points (pooled mean of the paired difference), and that difference is positive in at least 4 of 5 seeds, for each control

matching.chosen_arm: the rung or evaluated proposal with the best |S/S* - 1| (glq_match's record); its actor is the one locked
matching.extension: blind ladder extension, declared now: when the target exceeds every rung's strength of a family, rungs are appended at the top knob times the family's factor (even pull x2: nu = 4, 8, 16; the others x sqrt(10)) until a rung's strength reaches the target, at most 3 rungs; still unreachable -> that control has no matched arm and every mark that needs it fails
matching.rule: every gating control (even_pull, push_less, random_1, random_2) is matched blind to the perfect band's strength with the gate's matcher experiments/signal/glq_match.match_parallel (knob 0 = no caution, S = 0, leads every ladder; first rung within tol taken; else log-linear interpolation (linear from 0) then geometric bisection), tol 0.01, at most 5 rounds, strengths only, before any return is computed; the families run in parallel rounds

no_bca: No BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA training arm. Nothing from algorithms/td3_bc_bca.py, calibration/ or learners.bca_* is called (learners.py imports them; they are never called).

oracle.formula: delta*(s, a) = r(s, a) + 0.98 * min_h Q_h(s', c(s')) - min_h Q_h(s, a)
oracle.gradient: full derivative in a: through r, through s' (critic input and c(s')) and through Q(s, a)
oracle.parts: (s', r) = thruster_chain.dynamics_jax(s, a, physics): one exact simulator step from the row's state (prepared.states: the float64 of the float32 observation, exactly representable in float32), reward -(|s|^2 + 0.3 |clip(a)|^2) on the clipped command, thrust stalling past the knee as thruster_chain.thrust_jax; c = recorder.stall_aware (the critic's scored controller) on s'; Q_h the frozen critic's two heads at the float32-rounded normalised state ((float32(s) - mean) / std, learners' normalisation) and the command
oracle.precision: float32 inside the training program (the same dynamics_jax function); float64 version (dynamics_jax under enable_x64) computed for check (c); see deviations

other_runs.no_stall: no-stall comparison world, after the stalling world's lock of the same seed, not re-matched: none (check 2's 'no_stall_gapped' actor, reproduced by the gate's code path and checked by hash), perfect band k = 1 with the critic's own scored controller (stall-aware) for c(s'), perfect band k = 1 with the rising-thrust controller for c(s') (the plan's literal wording; reported), even pull at the stalling world's locked nu, range hinge (that world's own recorded range); critic: check 2's no-stall gapped critic; start: the no-stall cloned actor; the W = 0 check (b) against 'none' as well
other_runs.replication: check 3's critic (the frozen co-trained plain TD3+BC critic on the gapped log, alpha 5): none (check 3's saved 'none' actor; the new program with W = 0 must match it within 1e-5), perfect band k = 1 with c(s') = the host's own actor (its target copy, the actor the critic's own Bellman target reads, no smoothing noise), and the even pull matched blind to that perfect band's strength (ladder nu 0.1-2, same rule); the cloning term in check 3's per-row weighted form, as check 3 ran it; check 3's saved arms (harm_placed, strength_matched_even, cap2) are reused from its values.json for comparison

pre_spec_timing.note: random start actor (not the cloned actor), results discarded, no strength or return

run_order: 1. seeds 0 and 1: train (lock) then eval, one process each; 2. futility on seeds 0 and 1; 3. only if it says continue: seeds 2-4 (train, eval), then the no-stall arms (no_stall_train, no_stall_eval) and the replication on check 3's critic (replication_train, replication_eval) on seeds 0-4; 4. pooled marks over seeds 0-4. Every train phase writes its lock before its eval phase may run.

setup.arms_side_by_side: the arms of one penalty kind run vmapped in one program, as the gate runs its arms
setup.batch_rows: check 2's stream: np.random.default_rng([20261015, seed, 35]).integers(n_train_rows, size=(20000, 256)), the same rows for every arm
setup.critic: check 2's frozen fixed-controller critic of the stalling world on the gapped log (runs/shift/<prereg>/critics/base/stall/stall_aware_gap/seed<k>, read with acceptance.get_critic(prereg, sd, 'gap', 'stall_aware', train=False)); its scored policy is the stall-aware controller (recorder.stall_aware: the textbook gain clipped at +-0.8)
setup.protocol: check 2's actor-only protocol (acceptance.h2_seed's critic swap), unchanged

slope_normalisation: g_X = sqrt(mean over 4,096 training rows (default_rng([20261015, seed, 63]).choice(n, 4096, replace=False)) of ||grad_a W_X(s, a)||^2) at a = the cloned actor's command (before any training); g_band for W = |delta*|. A push-less or random-surface knob of 1 gives the same average command slope as the perfect band at k = 1. Outcome-free: no return, no strength enters it.

strength.definition: S = root-mean-square change of the command from the no-caution arm on the 5,000 evaluation-split recorded states (learners.strength on prepared.eval_obs; check 3's rule)
strength.region_check: the same on the full-throttle-region training states (prepared.region), reported
